ITEM 1 | Bite-sized pieces of light tan, glossy cooked meat with a shiny brown glaze, irregular cut edges, some pieces with white fibrous/fatty streaks, clustered across the center of a white square plate, roughly 2-4 cm chunks, about 45% of plate area, moderately thick (1.5-2.5 cm) | 210
ITEM 2 | Halved Brussels sprouts with bright green outer leaves, cut faces showing pale green interior, slightly browned edges, glossy with sauce, scattered among the meat pieces, each half about 2-3 cm across, several pieces on the right and bottom of the plate | 45
ITEM 3 | Thick yellow-orange cubes with a slightly golden, firm, smooth-looking surface, about 1.5-2 cm per side, a few pieces visible at the lower left and lower center edges partly under the meat | 25
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-brown pieces with wrinkled, slightly glossy skin, chunky, about 1.5-2 cm, scattered near the top center and bottom center, likely pieces of a dried or glazed fruit-like item with sticky sheen | 15
ITEM 5 | Thin brown sauce residue with glossy sheen, smeared in patches around the top edge and between food pieces on the white plate, thin film, low volume | 10
